citations.text: Analysis was performed using IBM SPSS Statistics for Windows v.22.0 (IBM Corp., Armonk, NY, USA). Quantitative variables were reported as the mean ± standard deviation and qualitative variables as the frequency and percentage. Because of the normal distribution of the data, the independent t-test was used to assess the difference in means. The χ2 test and Fisher's exact test were used to assess the statistical relationships between categorical variables. The level of significance was set at a P-value of <0.05 for all analyses.
